releases.name: Veltarum
releases.summary: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.

releases.name: PICK A BOO
releases.summary: PICK A BOO is an online co-op action game where you use magnetic powers to stick furniture together and haul it out.

releases.name: Meow Field
releases.summary: Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.

releases.name: GymPup
releases.summary: GymPup is a BL furry romance narrative game that combines idle desktop gameplay with visual novel elements. Accompany the protagonist and witness his transformation—both physical and emotional.

releases.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
releases.summary: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

releases.name: Another Card Game
releases.summary: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?

releases.name: Brick Buddies (Bunnyhop)
releases.summary: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.

releases.name: Defend The HexCore
releases.summary: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior | Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board | Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!

releases.name: The 9th Haunted Corridor
releases.summary: The 9th Haunted Corridor is a short horror game where you must spot anomalies in an endless corridor and survive the paranormal phenomena that await you. Observe your surroundings carefully, do not overlook any strange details, and escape from the infinite haunted corridor.

releases.name: Rubber Stamp Legend
releases.summary: An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp. Reject shameless "business expenses," outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!

releases.name: Necrogen
releases.summary: Defend a forest watchtower against waves of monsters in a first-person survival shooter. Earn cash from kills, buy weapons and upgrades, fight flying gargoyles, and face bosses in dedicated arenas. Spend your last dollars on ammo or repairs? The next round will test your choice.

releases.name: CARTA CHAIN: Maou-chan's Deal
releases.summary: Chain cards by matching suits or ranks, then use strategic sequencing and item combos to rack up explosive scores. Turn your debt-ridden life around at Maou-chan’s casino in this single-player card game.

releases.name: Armed Prisoner III
releases.summary: Armed Prisoner III is a 2D casual incremental idle electronic cricket game in which the core gameplay revolves around Bot AI characters using modern firearms to shoot and fight each other. The battles are random, chaotic, and unlimited in duration

releases.name: Mushroom Must Go Up!
releases.summary: One mouse, One mushroom, No chackpoints.

releases.name: Kaidanji
releases.summary: 山の中にてあなたは偶然にも、怪談寺に迷い込む――。そこにいたのは、正体不明の奇妙な4人の人物だった。聞かされる怪談話の数々。王道ホラーから人怖、SFホラー、ホラーコメディなど多岐に渡る怖い話を楽しめます。VHS風画面短編集ホラーノベルゲーム。

releases.name: Leviticus
releases.summary: Leviticus is a dark sci-fi action game where you play as an angel sent to guard those made in his image. Tasked with defending humanity, you patrol the stars and destroy alien intruders, beings that were never made in the image of God. Fight across space, uncover and enforce Heaven’s decree.

releases.name: DOPA-MATCH3: Cosmic Journey
releases.summary: The best-feeling match-3 game in the universe. Line up three gems and let them vanish with a twinkle. Fill the HEAT gauge and the ultimate combo time begins. Clear the LEVEL, pick an upgrade card, and grow permanently stronger for the long journey ahead.

releases.name: Haste Makes Waste
releases.summary: Start with an empty account and load the first cargo yourself. Hire and train workers, add wagons and expand your station and warehouse. In this railway idle game, watch the flow of goods, spot bottlenecks and decide which upgrade will make the biggest difference.

releases.name: Dub Party
releases.summary: A dubbing party game for you and your friends. Import a video clip, claim the roles and record every line in the booth, then watch the finished dub together and save it. Play solo, pass one mic around on the couch, or invite up to 7 friends online.

releases.name: Big Jhow Jet
releases.summary:
Prepare for takeoff! Strap on your homemade jetpack, defy gravity, and unleash total chaos to save your friends from the dreaded Bacon Factory!

Jhow is a brilliant, tech-obsessed piglet whose peaceful farm life is shattered when an ominous corporate truck kidnaps all his friends.

Refusing to be tomorrow's breakfast, Jhow heads to his secret workshop, fires up his custom-built jetpack, and takes to the skies as the ultimate high-speed hero: Big Jhow Jet!

In this frantic, physics-driven action-arcade game, momentum is everything. Blast out of a cannon and navigate a sky filled with targeted missiles, pigeon bombers, and ground-patrolling Bacon-Bots.

Manage your fuel, bounce off the asphalt, and master aerodynamics to reach maximum velocity.

Out of gas? The run isn't over! Use your last breath to initiate a heroic on-foot Sprint Dash, or rely on crazy power-ups and loyal helpers to keep the flight going!

releases.name: skl survivor
releases.summary: score attack game where you move forward and shoot continuously and must rotate change direction

releases.name: BACKROOMS TOGETHER: SURVIVAL ESCAPE
releases.summary:
Every step takes you deeper into the unknown.

Enter the endless maze of liminal spaces, where abandoned corridors, empty rooms, and flickering lights hide unsettling mysteries and unexpected dangers. In this eerie world, finding the way out is only the beginning of your struggle to survive.

Backrooms Together: Survival Escape is a cooperative survival adventure where you and your teammates must explore strange environments, overcome dangerous encounters, and search for an escape route. Stay alert, watch your surroundings, and work together to avoid getting lost in the endless maze.

Explore mysterious levels filled with winding corridors, deserted rooms, and unsettling silence. Every location presents new challenges, and one wrong turn can put your entire team in danger. Pay attention to your surroundings and think carefully before moving forward.

To help you survive, the company provides every explorer with three essential tools: a protective hazmat suit, a pistol, and a flashlight. Use your suit for protection, illuminate dark passages with your flashlight, and keep your pistol ready when threats stand in your way.

However, equipment alone is not enough to guarantee survival. Communication, teamwork, and trust are essential when navigating unpredictable environments. Coordinate your movements, help your teammates overcome obstacles, and make every decision count as you search for a way out.

releases.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria
releases.summary: Is the next card going to be higher or lower? Do you have what it takes to beat the odds?See if you can beat your best score or your friends. Great at parties or if you have a few minutes and want to pass the time.Get stuck in to the best Higher or Lower game going!

releases.name: Flashes of Chaos
releases.summary: A fast-paced roguelike top-down shooter about building brutal guns. Collect ammunition cards, add modifiers, and load them into your weapon of choice to create your own unique experience of pure, adrenaline-fueled destruction.

releases.name: Astrokicker
releases.summary: Mixing old and new, Astrokicker is inspired by classic shootemups going back to the 80s, with a few twists. The player gets to fly in any direction, and using a combination of skill and strategy, takes out the starbases controlling warpfields.

releases.name: Gregoire Lefebvre Investigations : The Vow of Hate
releases.summary: Play as Captain Grégoire Lefèbvre and investigate the murder of a controversial country priest in this gripping historical detective thriller.

releases.name: Grave Of Voices
releases.summary: Ryan Morgan, a 21-year-old horror vlogger, thought he had found the perfect lead for his next video. But when he enters Ashfall, a town erased from the map, he realizes he's trapped in the catacombs below. To escape, he must solve puzzles, scavenge, hide from inhuman creatures, and fight to survive.

releases.name: Annum Crossroads
releases.summary: Navigate a vast wilderness while battling countless enemies.

releases.name: Voody Hex
releases.summary: Voody Hex is a roguelite plateformer. Enter into a voodoo cabaret and curse yourself to increase difficulty. You cannot attack - You need to survive.

releases.name: Arcane Whispers: The Last Stand
releases.summary: Step into the role of Zephon, the last Guardian, in this third-person action-adventure. Harness the powers of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, carefully managing each element as you battle elemental foes, solve puzzles, and explore a shattered world of floating islands.

releases.name: No Alibi
releases.summary: Rob banks, collect bounties, and gamble it all away in No Alibi. Up to 4 players work together to lead their criminal empire to success. Use your customized guns and equipment to take hostages and steal everything you can. Just make sure the boss gets paid.

releases.name: Campfire Harmony
releases.summary:
An adorable fox lives on your desktop, reacting to your typing to keep a campfire burning. 

Earn coins, upgrade, and decorate a lakeside camp in a transparent overlay. 

Cozy, zero-stress companion for work or study.

releases.name: Rosavane Borers LLC
releases.summary: Rosavane Borers LLC is a mining exploration simulator. Excavate underground caverns to uncover rare gems and valuable ores. Customize your miner, upgrade your tools, and delve ever deeper in a hand‑drawn pixel world!

releases.name: Ritual : House Sitting
releases.summary: A young woman named Nina accepts a house-sitting job recommended by a friend, tempted by the unusually generous pay. But is the house really as ordinary as it seems?

releases.name: Pirate Treasure: Tidy Up!
releases.summary: Attention, greenhorn! Prove you’re worthy of joining the crew by tidying up our chaotic treasure vault. Sort every piece of loot into its rightful place, upgrade your sluggish hands with hooks and peglegs, and discover hidden skills along the way!

releases.name: Hking's Block Arena
releases.summary: Up to twelve cube robots, one grid, one shot then reload. A couch-first party shooter: Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, King of the Hill, Juggernaut and Gun Game - up to 8 players on one screen, online with friends over Steam, or against bots.

releases.name: Serena's Alchemy Life
releases.summary: Shape five years of adventure in Serena's Alchemy Life, a fantasy RPG of alchemy and friendship. Explore 50 areas, craft 169 types of items, and battle 600 monster species alongside two companions. Complete guild requests, strengthen your bonds, and let your choices lead to one of 11 endings.

releases.name: AMMO DUMP
releases.summary: A first-person incremental shooter about one cube. Shoot it until it breaks and a bigger one slams down from the sky. Grab rounds from the ammo piles, chase bullseyes and gold cubes, and grow a skill tree from one pistol to lightning storms, turrets, meteors and a sun.
